_aliases_note: Employer aliases are listed explicitly rather than matched fuzzily. LinkedIn writes 'Royal Bank of Canada' where Workday writes 'RBC', and guessing that two names are one employer risks merging two real jobs into one, which hides a listing. An unlisted alias only causes a visible duplicate, which is the safer failure.
